mode: recorded Prisma v3.0 transcripts (2026-11-04), re-run through the production pipeline now; no API calls
naive_definition: A baseline we wrote, not a real product: the same transcript parsing as Clariflow, then 'save as heard' with no checks (first asset candidate, Celsius assumed, spoken hour kept as-is, missing unit left blank, contradictions saved as fact, last value wins, nothing asked). On audio it uses plain verbatim STT.

scenarios.title: Spoken correction
scenarios.what_it_tests: The speaker says one pressure, corrects it, and never states a unit. The corrected value must win, the old one must stay visible as history, and the missing unit must be asked, not assumed.
scenarios.provenance: real Prisma v3.0 transcript of Anvay's recording, 2026-11-04
